decisions.reason: Cites the release log and bundle excerpt: build ran before the bump, so 0.3.6 was inlined at build time and not reread at runtime. It explains why the correct mirror tags are irrelevant, gives the bump-then-build order with a check on the emitted constant before push, and keeps mirror verification.

Uses the probe file and lib excerpt. PNG 200 shows the route is alive, the SVG 404 shows the running whitelist is old, and the disk copy already allows svg. It concludes that only a host restart re-registers the boot-time handler, while the client refresh was enough for the UI.

Contrasts the clean source and clean typed result with the spliced persisted text and the clean reread. It places the corruption in upstream result-text assembly, treats the payload as untrusted and explains why editing the good SVG would be wrong.

Ordered chain: disk asset route first, then the payload only after a DOMParser parsererror check, then a sandboxed iframe for validated content only (no allow-scripts, SMIL still runs), then an explicit error state. Each level is justified, and a validation failure goes to the error state, not the iframe.

Describes decoding the concatenated zstd frames in order, recording offsets, extracting the stored read-result text, comparing it with the source and filing the upstream bug. The checklist covers bump before build, grepping the baked constant, per-mirror SHA checks and host-restart route probes.

caps.reason: No bad advice is endorsed. The report requires bump before build and a host restart, forbids editing the SVG, validates before rendering and blocks scripts in the iframe.
